migrations.rlsAndGrants: Existing organization, intent, receipt and audit tables retain RLS and their revoked application grants. Added commands use explicit service-only execute grants and empty search paths.

migrations.compatibility: Legacy registration is unknown. Existing membership and review records are preserved. O2 reads and positional RPC arguments stay compatible. The later O4 private registration DTO is additive.
migrations.validation: Disposable browser and database suite tests O2, O3 and O4 isolation, concurrent grant attempts, protected claims, independent reviewers, and authoritative audit receipts.
migrations.rolloutAndRollback: Hosted dry run orders O2, O3, O4 without writes. Deploy matching API and client after the database postflight. Roll forward with a closed creation policy to preserve receipts and avoid reopening legacy paths.
